hook.text: What does the number in front do?

youtube.title: Amplitude: the height of a wave 📈 #shorts
youtube.description:
Multiply sin x by a number and the wave gets taller. In sound, a taller wave is a louder sound. Here, a taller curve also reaches higher notes.

#math #learn #shorts
youtube.tags: math, physics, learn, education, science, satisfying, shorts

texts.text: y = sin x: one gentle wave

hook.text: What does the number inside do?

youtube.title: Frequency: how many waves fit 〰️ #shorts
youtube.description:
Multiply x inside the sine and the waves squeeze together. More waves per second is a higher frequency: a higher pitch.

#math #learn #shorts
youtube.tags: math, physics, learn, education, science, satisfying, shorts

hook.text: Is cosine just a moved sine?

youtube.title: Phase shift: sine and cosine are the same wave 🔁 #shorts
youtube.description:
Subtract a number inside the sine and the whole wave slides to the right. Slide it by a quarter turn (π/2) and you get the cosine.

#math #learn #shorts
youtube.tags: math, physics, learn, education, science, satisfying, shorts

texts.text: sin(x − 1): the same wave, moved right
cos x is sin x shifted by π/2

hook.text: What do two waves make together?

youtube.title: Add two waves, get a new one ➕ #shorts
youtube.description:
Waves simply add, point by point. A slow wave plus a fast one makes a wobbly shape. Every sound you hear is made of sine waves added up like this.

#math #learn #shorts
youtube.tags: math, physics, learn, education, science, satisfying, shorts

hook.text: Can smooth waves make sharp corners?

youtube.title: Smooth sines add up to a square wave ⬛ #shorts
youtube.description:
Add sin x, sin 3x/3, sin 5x/5 … the odd harmonics, each smaller than the last. The sum gets closer and closer to a square wave: the Fourier series.

#math #learn #shorts
youtube.tags: math, physics, learn, education, science, satisfying, shorts

hook.text: What does the slope sound like?

youtube.title: Slope: how fast a line climbs 📐 #shorts
youtube.description:
In y = m·x + b, m is the slope: how much the line climbs for every step to the right. A steeper line rises in pitch faster; a negative slope falls.

#math #learn #shorts
youtube.tags: math, physics, learn, education, science, satisfying, shorts

texts.text: y = x: up one for every step right

hook.text: How do you move a parabola?

youtube.title: Parabolas: move and flip a U 🎢 #shorts
youtube.description:
y = x² makes a U. Subtract inside the bracket and it moves sideways; add outside and it moves up; a minus sign flips it upside down. Thrown balls fly in parabolas.

#math #learn #shorts
youtube.tags: math, physics, learn, education, science, satisfying, shorts

youtube.title: Exponential growth and decay 📉 #shorts
youtube.description:
2^x doubles with every step: exponential growth. e^(−x) keeps halving: decay. Multiply a wave by decay and you get the shape of a plucked string fading away.

#math #learn #shorts
youtube.tags: math, physics, learn, education, science, satisfying, shorts

youtube.title: Absolute value: flip the negatives ⤴️ #shorts
youtube.description:
Absolute value turns every negative number positive. A line becomes a V, a sine wave becomes a row of bumps, and with decay it becomes a bouncing ball.

#math #learn #shorts
youtube.tags: math, physics, learn, education, science, satisfying, shorts

presets.name: Lesson · The Sound of a Formula

hook.text: What does a graph sound like?

youtube.title: Listen to a graph: height = pitch 🎵 #shorts
youtube.description:
The pen moves along the graph and its height sets the pitch. A rising line is a rising note, a falling line falls, a wave sounds like a siren.

#math #learn #shorts
youtube.tags: math, physics, learn, education, science, satisfying, shorts

texts.text: Higher on the graph = higher note
A wave goes up and down: a siren

hook.text: Where do synth sounds come from?

youtube.title: Sawtooth, square, triangle: the synth waves 🎛️ #shorts
youtube.description:
Three simple functions make the three classic synth waves: mod gives a sawtooth, the sign of a sine gives a square, and straight ramps up and down give a triangle.

#math #learn #shorts
youtube.tags: math, physics, learn, education, science, satisfying, shorts

texts.text: mod(x, 1): climb and drop, a sawtooth
sign(sin x): only up or down, a square
Straight ramps up and down: a triangle

hook.text: What if distance depends on the angle?

youtube.title: Polar curves: circles, hearts and spirals 🌀 #shorts
youtube.description:
In polar form you give the distance r for every angle θ. A constant draws a circle, 1 + cos θ draws a heart, and r growing with θ draws a spiral.

#math #learn #shorts
youtube.tags: math, physics, learn, education, science, satisfying, shorts

texts.text: r = 2: the same distance everywhere, a circle
r = 0.2θ: further each turn, a spiral

hook.text: How many petals does cos 2θ have?

youtube.title: Rose curves: count the petals 🌹 #shorts
youtube.description:
r = cos(nθ) draws a rose. Odd n gives n petals, even n gives 2n petals. So cos 2θ has 4, cos 3θ has 3 and cos 5θ has 5.

#math #learn #shorts
youtube.tags: math, physics, learn, education, science, satisfying, shorts

texts.text: r = 2.6 cos 5θ: 5 petals (odd n gives n)

hook.text: What if x and y both follow a formula?

youtube.title: Parametric curves: circle, ellipse, Lissajous ➰ #shorts
youtube.description:
Give x and y each their own formula of s and the pen draws a path. Cos and sin draw a circle, stretching one draws an ellipse, and different speeds draw a Lissajous figure.

#math #learn #shorts
youtube.tags: math, physics, learn, education, science, satisfying, shorts

texts.text: x = cos s, y = sin s: a circle
x = sin 3s, y = sin 2s: a Lissajous knot
